title: Skillflow: overview film
description: Agent skills that review your pages. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 47 seconds: Skillflow for TYPO3 v14. Reviews in your workflow; A report for every run; A page for every skill. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: SEO, accessibility and tone rules live in one person’s head, so every draft gets a different check.
Skillflow runs agent skills on pages and workspace stages, and keeps every report.
Assign skills to a workspace stage, and every record sent there gets reviewed.
Each run keeps its status, its engine and a Markdown report.
Active skills become a searchable catalogue, with a page for each skill.
Skillflow. Reports your team can check.
